arguments.message: shaft power well above what lasts to the finish

arguments.condition: elapsed_s > 240 and remaining_m > 1500 and shaft_power_w < 0.9 * sustainable_shaft_power_w
arguments.message: shaft power well below what lasts to the finish
boat slower than pod power predicts: drag (rudder weed?) or local current
pod reads near zero while boat moves: pod failure?
pod reserve low with far to go

arguments.text: Plan (min 1): 10 km, ~55 min, so race at about critical power (shaft ~160-165 W, boat ~100-103 W); hard start is normal, let it settle by min 3. Watches set: overpace, underpace, drag (push_local well below push_along = weed/drag?), pod_fail, reserve_low, finish_plan at 1600 m left. Early push_along -0.18 (against on leg 1, should help on the way back). Trust pod over boat-speed numbers if they disagree.

text: no cue: hard start is normal and should settle; set watches for pacing, drag, pod failure, low reserve and the finish, and noted the plan.

arguments.text: Good start. Settle now, ease a touch to race pace.
Min 4: still 175 W shaft vs 164 sustainable, pod reserve 71% and draining (boat reserve 60%). Cued a small ease (no pace target). Check next wake-up that shaft settles near 160-165 W and not lower.

text: Cued a small ease: shaft power 7% above what lasts to the finish and reserve draining at minute 4.

arguments.name: boat_eff
arguments.description: share of shaft power reaching the boat (boat power / pod power)

arguments.message: boat power per pod watt dropped: drag (weed) or tired blade or current

arguments.text: Min 7: settled at 164 W shaft = sustainable; pod reserve 64%, boat reserve 53%. Boat/pod power ratio slid 0.65 (min 3) to 0.61 (min 7); speed at same rate -3%. Added boat_eff metric + eff_drop watch (<0.56) to catch weed/drag. Turn at 1250 m now.

arguments.name: boat_eff
arguments.description: share of shaft power reaching the boat (boat power / pod power)

text: no cue: settled at sustainable power after the ease; added a boat-power-per-pod-watt metric and watch to catch drag such as weed.

arguments.text: Min 10 (1.8 km, leg 2 with current helping +0.19): shaft 167 W (sustainable 163), pod reserve 57%, no fade (+0.2%). Boat reserve 30% is current-contaminated, ignore it. Paddler says effort 3/10, plenty left: hint that tested CP (159 shaft) is low. Plan: ask again ~min 14-16; if still <=5/10 with no fade while pod reserve falls below ~45%, raise cp_shaft ~8% and cue a small push.

text: no cue: on sustainable pod power, no fade; paddler reports 3/10, so gathering more evidence that critical power is set too low before pushing.

arguments.text: Nice and steady. Back off a hair, long way to go.

Min 13 (2.4 km): shaft crept up to 170 W vs sustainable 163, pod reserve 47%, no fade. Paddler 4/10 (was 3/10 at min 10), says plenty: a rise like that fits on-pace effort building, so not strong evidence CP is low. Boat/pod ratio is higher on the south legs (current fit off), so boat reserve (12%) is unreliable. Cued a small ease. Next evidence: if pod reserve falls below ~15% with no fade and effort still moderate, raise cp_shaft.

text: Cued a small ease: pod power had crept 4% above what lasts to the finish with the pod reserve under half.

arguments.text: Min 16 (2.9 km, leg 3 north): after 2nd ease shaft 163 = sustainable, pod reserve 43% and lasts past finish. Boat reserve reads 0% and boat power 115 W but NO fade (+1.8%): boat numbers are inflated by the current fit (push_along -0.20 vs pod-based push_local -0.12). Do NOT act on boat reserve or cp_implied from it; pace on the pod. No cue.

text: no cue: pod power on the sustainable line and reserve lasts to the finish; boat-speed reserve of 0% is a current-fit artifact (no fade).

arguments.message: speed through water dropped below 2.90: paddler slowing or drag (weed)

arguments.text: Min 18.4 POD DRIFT: shaft power ramped 163 -> 133 W over ~2 min while GPS speed (2.86 on north leg), water speed (3.05) and rate (59) stayed flat. Pod is reading ~18% low, the paddler did not ease. Ignore pod power, pod reserve, push_local, boat_eff from now on (removed pod-based watches; underpace alert was false). Pace on speed through water: steady effort gave ~3.0-3.08 m/s; watches slow_water <2.90 and fast_water >3.20. GPS ref at this effort: north legs ~2.86, south legs ~3.23.

text: no cue: the underpace alert is a paddle-pod drift (pod power fell 18% while boat speed and rate held), so no push; now pacing on speed through the water.
no cue: just out of the turn, speed means still include the turn; drifted pod reads a steady 133 W so effort looks unchanged. Recheck south-leg GPS speed (expect ~3.2) next wake-up.

arguments.text: Feeling strong. Lift the pace slightly, smooth and long.

Min 24.4 (4.4 km): steady, water 3.01-3.02, south GPS 3.20, no fade, drifted pod steady 133. Paddler 4/10 again (4/10 at min 13 too): effort not rising over 11 min = likely below true CP. Cued a SMALL push. Check at ~min 28-29: ask_paddler; aim water ~3.06-3.08 (drifted pod ~138-140). If effort jumps to >=6/10 or speed fades, ease back. Keep reserve for a finish from ~1.2-1.5 km out.

text: Cued a small push: effort has stayed at 4/10 for 11 minutes with no fade, so the paddler is likely below their true critical power.

arguments.text: Min 27.5 (5.0 km, halfway, leg 5 north): push was followed (drifted pod 133 -> 143, now 139; water 3.07 then 3.02 through the turn). Paddler now 5/10 (was 4/10 before push). Holding here, no cue. Next ~min 31-32: ask again; if still 5/10, another small push is OK; if 6+ and rising, let it settle.

text: no cue: push followed and effort now 5/10 at halfway; letting it settle before deciding on more.

arguments.text: Ease a touch, stay smooth. Save it for the finish.

Min 30.4 (5.5 km): push faded (drifted pod back to 134-137), water 3.03, no fade, rate 58. But effort jumped 5 -> 7/10 in 3 min. Best guess now: tested CP roughly right after all (true sustainable ~ drifted pod 133); the push spent some reserve. Cued a small ease to protect against blow-up. Check effort ~min 34: if <=7 and steady, hold; if 8+, ease again. Finish push from ~1.2 km out, harder only if effort allows.

text: Cued a small ease: effort rose from 5 to 7 out of 10 in three minutes with 4.5 km left, so protecting against running out before the finish.

arguments.text: Min 33.4 (6.0 km): after ease, drifted pod 131-133, water 2.97, speed at same rate -1.8% (mostly the ease). Effort back down 7 -> 6/10. Holding, no cue. Finish plan: at ~1500 m left check effort; if <=7 cue a moderate push; cue finish (sprint) at ~450-500 m left. Watch speed per pod watt for weed/drag (water 2.97 at 131 vs 3.03-3.05 at 133 earlier, slightly low).

text: no cue: effort eased back to 6/10 and pace is near sustainable; holding until the finish plan at 1500 m left.

arguments.text: Hold this pace, not yet. Big push at 1500 to go.

Min 35.5 (6.4 km, leg 6 south): paddler said Feeling great, I am going (wants to surge with 3.6 km left; effort was 6/10 at min 33). Cued HOLD, promised a push at 1500 m to go. Speed per pod watt slightly lower (fade -1.9% before the turn, pod constant 132): watch for drag/weed vs blade fatigue.

text: Cued hold: the paddler wanted to surge with 3.6 km left, too early for the reserve; promised a push at 1500 m to go.

arguments.message: cue gate open again: cue clear_rudder now (paddler reported heavy boat, speed at same effort down ~3.5%)

arguments.text: Min 35.9 (6.46 km): paddler says boat feels heavy, something on the rudder? Instruments agree: speed at same rate -3.7%, south-leg water speed ~2.91 vs ~3.02 earlier at the same drifted pod power (133); GPS 3.08 vs 3.20. Likely weed. Cue gate blocked 40 s, so set watch cue_ready_rudder. ACTION when woken by it: cue clear_rudder. Afterwards check speed recovers to ~3.0 water / ~3.2 GPS south.

text: no cue yet (gate closed for 40 s): heavy boat plus a 3.7% speed loss at unchanged effort points to weed; set a watch to wake me when I can cue clear_rudder.

arguments.text: Weed likely. Quick back-stroke to clear the rudder, then settle.

Min 36.6 (6.59 km): cued clear_rudder (fade -4.4%, water 2.89 at unchanged drifted pod 132-133). Check next wake-up: south-leg water speed back to ~3.0 and fade back near -1%? If not cleared and paddler still says heavy, try clear_rudder once more.

text: Cued clear_rudder: paddler felt the boat go heavy and speed at unchanged effort is down 4.4%, which fits weed on the rudder.
no cue: slow-water alert came seconds after the clear_rudder cue, before it can act; judge the effect at the next wake-up.

arguments.text: Min 39.9 (7.18 km): rudder cleared - fade back from -4.4/-6.7% to -2.0%, water 2.96, south GPS 3.12. Drifted pod slipping 132 -> 128, rate 58 -> 57: watch for tiring. Next: finish_plan watch at 1600 m left -> ask effort, then cue push at ~1500 m left (promised), finish sprint at ~450-500 m left.

text: no cue: rudder cleared and speed recovered; holding until the planned push at 1500 m to go.

arguments.message: 1000 m to go: cue push (moderate), sprint comes at ~400 m
~400 m to go: cue finish (final sprint)

arguments.text: Min 42.9 (7.7 km, leg 7 north): effort 8/10 (6 at min 33), fade creeping -1.9 -> -3.5% at constant drifted pod 129-132, no heavy-boat report: more likely tiring than weed (weed came with a report and a step). Est. true reserve ~25% (about 5 kJ). REVISED finish: moderate push at 1000 m left (watch push_point), finish sprint at ~400 m left (watch sprint_point). If paddler reports heavy boat or fade drops below -5%, clear_rudder.

text: no cue: effort 8/10 and slight fade suggest tiring, so moved the push to 1000 m left and the sprint to 400 m left, with watches to time them.
no cue: steady at race pace with fade stable near -3%; push cue waits for the 1000 m watch.

arguments.text: Yes, go now. Build smoothly, sprint at four hundred to go.

arguments.message: 1000 m to go: push already cued at 1640 m; check it has not faded (drifted pod should be above ~140), re-push only if faded and fade not worse than -5%

arguments.text: Min 46.8 (1640 m left, north leg into current, turn at ~1250 m left): paddler asked to go harder; effort was 8/10 at 2.3 km. Pushing into the current pays most, so cued PUSH now (said sprint at 400 to go). Drifted pod before push ~131. Plan: at 1000 m check push held; cue finish at ~400 m (sprint_point watch). If speed collapses or fade < -6%, ease.

text: Cued push with 1640 m left: paddler asked to go harder and extra effort into the current on this leg pays most; sprint planned at 400 m to go.

arguments.text: Final leg. Lift again, long strong strokes.

Min 49.8 (1125 m left, final south leg): first push only modest (drifted pod 131 -> 135-138, water ~2.93). Cued a second push now. Next: sprint_point watch at 420 m left -> cue finish. Est. true reserve ~4 kJ.

text: Cued a second push on the final leg: the first push was only modest and about 4 kJ of reserve is estimated left; sprint cue waits for 420 m to go.

arguments.text: Breathe, recover, stay long. Sprint comes at three fifty.

arguments.message: 350 m to go: cue finish (final sprint) if speed has recovered at all

arguments.text: Min 51.9 (744 m left): BLOW-UP after the 2nd push - drifted pod 138 -> 102, water 2.97 -> 2.72, fade -10% (pod and speed fell together, so not weed). Cued reassure (no change) to let the reserve refill below CP. Moved sprint_point to 350 m: cue finish then (gate allows; last 100 m no cues).

text: Cued reassure: the paddler blew up after the second push (power and speed fell together), so letting them recover before a short sprint at 350 m.

arguments.text: Three fifty to go. Sprint now, everything to the line!

text: Cued the final sprint at 346 m: the paddler had recovered from the blow-up (power and speed back up), so spend what is left to the line.
